notes: No licensed music or SFX asset exists for this project. The music bed, room tone, and whoosh SFX are synthesized locally with FFmpeg and labelled synthesized in every record. Scene ambience (attic birdsong, forest wind, stream, meadow, garden) is represented by the room-tone bed and the whoosh transitions only — no ambience track is fabricated. Intentional silence is recorded here and in the QC report so it is never flagged as a defect.

silences.reason: Music tail-out under the end card; not a defect.
